desc: The Prodigy Comp from Springfield Armory takes the proven 1911 platform and enhances it with double-stack capacity and a performance-driven feature set. Reconfigured around a double-stack magazine, the polymer grip module mounts to a forged steel frame, offering capacities of 17+1 and 20+1. The AOS-compatible slide and barrel assembly is integrally compensated to reduce muzzle rise, while a Picatinny rail is ready to accept today's most popular accessories. The Prodigy Comp combines the most beloved characteristics of the 1911 with modern capacity for unrivaled performance.
